ex.en: I got a good grade in English.
ex.zh: 我英文成績很好。

ex.en: I made efforts to improve my grades.
ex.zh: 我努力提高成績。

ex.en: I got terrible grades this term.
ex.zh: 我這個學期的成績很差。

ex.en: My son is in the third grade.
ex.zh: 我兒子讀三年級。

ex.en: She skipped a grade because she was so smart.
ex.zh: 她因為太聰明而跳了一級。

ex.en: The teacher is grading our essays this weekend.
ex.zh: 老師這個週末在改我們的作文。

ex.en: Eggs are graded by size.
ex.zh: 雞蛋依大小分級。

ex.en: She was only 18 when she graduated from university.
ex.zh: 她十八歲就大學畢業了。

ex.en: I've got a feeling that Tom won't graduate this year.
ex.zh: 我覺得湯姆今年畢不了業。

ex.en: He went back to the village after he graduated.
ex.zh: 他畢業後回到了鄉下。

ex.en: The principal presented each of the graduates with diploma.
ex.zh: 校長頒發畢業證書給每一位畢業生。

ex.en: She is a graduate of National Taiwan University.
ex.zh: 她是台灣大學的畢業生。

ex.en: He is a graduate student in physics.
ex.zh: 他是物理研究所的學生。

ex.en: Graduate school is more focused on research.
ex.zh: 研究所更注重研究。

ex.en: Mrs. Parker greeted him with a smile.
ex.zh: 帕克太太微笑著跟他打招呼。

ex.en: Susan greeted her guests at the door.
ex.zh: 蘇珊在門口迎接她的客人。

ex.en: I didn't greet you because I mistook you for somebody else.
ex.zh: 我把你認成了別人，所以才沒有和你打招呼。

ex.en: I'd be very grateful if you could help me.
ex.zh: 如果你能幫我，我會非常感激。

ex.en: I'm very grateful for everything you've done for me.
ex.zh: 非常感謝你為我做的一切。

ex.en: I'm grateful to you for inviting me to the party.
ex.zh: 謝謝你邀我參加派對。

ex.en: I live with my mother, brother and my grandparents.
ex.zh: 我和媽媽，弟弟還有爺爺奶奶住在一起。

ex.en: Lucy was brought up by her grandparents.
ex.zh: 露西是祖父母帶大的。

ex.en: Tom went to Boston to spend Christmas with his grandparents.
ex.zh: 湯姆去波士頓陪爺爺奶奶過聖誕節。

ex.en: I bought a handmade dried persimmon in Hsinchu. It tastes sweet but not greasy.
ex.zh: 我在新竹買了一塊手工柿餅，吃起來甜而不膩。

ex.en: This fried rice is too greasy.
ex.zh: 這盤炒飯太油了。

ex.en: No gratuity accepted.
ex.zh: 本店不收小費。

ex.en: A 10% gratuity is added to the bill.
ex.zh: 帳單會另加 10% 的小費。

ex.en: The graph shows a steady increase in prices.
ex.zh: 這張曲線圖顯示價格穩定上升。

ex.en: Plot the results on a graph.
ex.zh: 把結果畫在圖表上。
